title: Seven Enclosures
translation: Seven were its enclosing sticks, thrice seven its fuel sticks, when the gods, performing the sacrifice, bound the Purusha as the offering.
translation_hi: उसकी सात परिधियाँ थीं और तीन गुना सात समिधाएँ बनाई गईं, जब देवताओं ने यज्ञ करते हुए पुरुष को पशु रूप में बाँधा।
